Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0033 2026-10-24
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-10-24
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0008, TEAM-0003
Subject: Retiring the Single-Line Queue Cover Form
Decision: From 2026-10-26, DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA will stop using the
single-line queue cover form for new paperwork. Its combined
responsible-party line made it difficult to distinguish an owning team, a
receiving reviewer, and the role arranging the next contact.
The replacement layout provides separate spaces for those roles, the locating
reference, the question requiring a decision, and the next contact time.
Existing papers retain their original form. Add a dated cross-reference sheet
when a later discussion needs the new layout, preserving the earlier cover
rather than silently recopying its contents.
The station records clerk will move unused old forms to a clearly labelled
reference folder. Keep a blank specimen for interpreting earlier paperwork,
but remove it from the tray used for new requests. This preserves filing
history without encouraging the old layout to circulate again.
Use DEMO-AIR-0008 and ISSUE-0081 to locate the hydraulics example.
TASK-0082, TASK-0083, and TASK-0084 may identify separate attachment
references; the form change does not combine their responsibilities.
Implementation: PERSON-0008 will give the new blank layout to the station
clerk on 2026-10-25. The desk coordinator will check the first handover using
it for role clarity and record any ambiguous label beside the specimen retained
for teaching.
D. Worker 0003
Demo Worker 0003, Demo Team 03
